'''Takeel''' was a [[Snivvian]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a [[mercenary]] and was addicted to [[spice]]. He and his brother [[Zutton]] frequented [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] and were present in the [[cantina]] in [[1 BBY]] when the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered.

Takeel sat a table near the entrance to the cantina with a variety of other patrons throughout his stay, including the moisture farmer [[Eyvind]], the [[Jawa]] [[Het Nkik]], and the [[Nimbanel]] [[Mosep Binneed]].

==Biography==
Takeel was a [[spice]]-addicted [[Snivvian]] who worked as a [[mercenary]]<ref name="SWCL" /> and frequented [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]]<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="SWCL" /> with his brother [[Zutton]]. As with most Snivvians, the brothers were frequently referred to as "snaggletooths."<ref name="Alien Archive" /> Takeel and Zutton were present in the [[cantina]]<ref name="ANH" /> in [[1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> when the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered with his [[droid]]s, [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]].<ref name="ANH" />

While Skywalker stood in the entryway to the cantina with the droids, Takeel sat down opposite a [[human]] patron at a table at the base of the steps down into the cantina, taking the seat of another human who had been sitting there when Skywalker entered.<ref name="ANH" /> The moisture farmer [[Eyvind]] then took the place of the human Takeel was sat opposite, and there pair were sharing a drink together when the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] defended Skywalker from the thugs [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]].<ref name="SWCL" />

When a [[Foot Patrol 7|group]] of [[Desert stormtrooper|sandtroopers]] entered the bar searching for Skywalker, Takeel watched them walk past his table. A [[Ranat]] and<ref name="ANH" /> the [[Jawa]] [[Het Nkik]]<ref name="SWCL" /> were sat next to Takeel at the table when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] shot the [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]], which caused the trio to all quickly look up toward the source of the [[blaster]]fire.<ref name="ANH" /> The [[Nimbanel]] [[Mosep Binneed]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> then took the seat opposite Takeel before the Snivvian watched Solo exit the cantina.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Takeel had light skin, [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s, and patchy brown [[hair]] with bald spots.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
While in Mos Eisley, Takeel wore a [[Color|red]] tunic over a black shirt<ref name="ANH" /> with brown pants and [[Clothing|shoes]].<ref name="SWCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Takeel was portrayed by [[Alf Mangan]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
